title: Effect of an input-only action
statement: Let a configuration with input $x$ have state $st$, input-head position $ip$, register tapes $rt$ and positions $rp$, decider tapes $dt$ and positions $dp$, and output $out$. An action that moves the input head by $mv_I$, leaves every work tape unchanged, emits no output, and enters state $st'$ sends this configuration to the one with state $st'$, input-head position moved by the clamped move $mv_I$, and all work tapes, head positions, and output unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $m,d,k_D$ are natural numbers; $\Lambda,SD$ are state types
$st$ is an optional program state and $st'$ is a program state
$rt,dt$ are tape-content functions and $rp,dp$ are head-position functions
